label: Opening Hook
text: A 600-year-old book written in an unknown script has defeated every attempt to read it.
title: File:Voynich Manuscript (135).jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Its vellum is radiocarbon-dated to 1404-1438 About 240 pages with drawings of unidentified plants, star charts and bathing figures Named after book dealer Wilfrid Voynich, who acquired it in 1912 Studied without success by WWII-era codebreakers including William Friedman Held at Yale's Beinecke Library; theories range from cipher to unknown language to elaborate hoax
